title: Course Projects
subtitle: Course projects, course labs, team assignments, and my undergraduate thesis. They record how I turned coursework requirements at different stages into runnable systems, experiment code, and engineering documents.
viewAllDescription: Browse course projects, lab repositories, and team assignments in reverse chronological order.

parallel-programming-2026.title: Parallel Programming A Assignments
parallel-programming-2026.summary: A BUAA graduate course repository for Parallel Programming A, organized around experiment problems, code, scripts, and run records.

images.mpiMatrixProcessTimeline: MPI large-scale matrix multiplication process timeline
images.mpiMatrixTimeResult: MPI large-scale matrix multiplication timing result

points: Uses C, Makefile, Shell, and Python to organize experiment code and helper scripts so the experiment flow can be reproduced.
Records the evolution from serial implementations to parallel implementations for typical problems and classic libraries in the parallel programming course.

vr-experiments-2026.title: Virtual Reality Integrated Experiments
vr-experiments-2026.summary: A BUAA graduate course assignment repository for Virtual Reality Integrated Experiments.
points: Organizes project files and explanatory materials for virtual reality course experiments.

os2023.title: MOS Operating System Labs
os2023.summary: BUAA Operating System labs, divided into six major labs. Each lab includes take-home code completion and an in-class code completion or new-feature implementation exam.

images.shellTimeRefill: Shell program timing with fast refill

points: Read a large amount of operating system code and developed a deeper understanding of how an operating system works.
Kept asking and answering my own questions, leaving behind a large set of lab notes.
Used GXemul to emulate the MIPS R3000 processor, with implementation in C and MIPS assembly.
Includes core operating system functions such as paged memory management, process management, inter-process communication, exception handling, a file system, and a Shell.

As an extra-credit task, I studied the page table structure, operated the $k0 and $k1 registers and the coprocessor, and implemented full page-table fast refill, reducing process context saving on TLB misses and achieving about a 4x speedup in specific cases.

parallel-architecture-2025.title: Parallel Processing and Architecture Assignment
parallel-architecture-2025.summary: Basic assignment code and report for BUAA graduate course Parallel Processing and Architecture, centered on convolution computation and performance optimization.

images.ompDataScalePerformance: Effect of data scale on OMP program performance
images.ompThreadCountPerformance: Effect of thread count on OMP program performance
images.ompThreadBindingPerformance: Effect of OMP thread binding on performance
images.numaBindingCpuUsage: CPU usage comparison before and after NUMA binding
images.perfFftOptimizationTable: Performance comparison table before and after Perf-guided FFT optimization
images.luPerfHotspots: Perf hotspots of original LU program with 64 threads
images.luDrcctprofComparison: DrCCTProf analysis comparison before and after LU optimization

points: Designed and implemented OpenMP programs with different kinds of parallel bottlenecks, optimized those bottlenecks, and tested performance before and after optimization under different thread counts and data scales.
Observed how compiler optimization, OpenMP thread binding, and NUMA binding affect parallel program performance through experiments.

Used call-path and performance analysis tools such as DrCCTProf and Linux Performance Counters to analyze classic parallel algorithm implementations, identify bottlenecks, optimize them, and verify the results experimentally.

road-accident-risk.title: Road Accident Risk Prediction
road-accident-risk.summary: A BUAA graduate Machine Learning course experiment assignment. A data analysis and modeling project for road accident risk prediction, including preprocessing, analysis, models, and report materials.

images.numericFeatureTargetCorrelation: Correlation between numeric features and target variable

points: Used Python for data preprocessing and analysis to guide feature engineering.
Based on domain knowledge, combined multiple key risk factors and created cross features and basic risk features.
Built a risk prediction model with XGBoost and used Optuna for hyperparameter search.

kernel-analysis-thesis.title: Research and Implementation of Fine-Grained Performance Analysis Techniques for Intelligent Computing Tasks
kernel-analysis-thesis.summary: My BUAA Software Engineering undergraduate thesis project.

images.researchStatus: Domestic and international research status analysis
images.dataFlow: Fine-grained performance prediction model data flow
images.yolov8ThroughputPrediction: YOLOv8 GPU compute throughput utilization prediction capability

points: Decomposed deep model computation graphs, mapped their operators to concrete GPU kernels in execution sequences, generated fine-grained operator load graphs, also known as kernel-level computation graphs, and explored the patterns and influencing factors of operator-to-kernel mappings to guide modeling.

Built multi-dimensional feature prediction models for tasks, capturing compute and memory-access characteristics of intelligent computing tasks at a fine granularity, and verified their effectiveness through experiments to support later interference analysis and task scheduling.
Developed automated tools to improve the automation level of the performance analysis and modeling workflow as much as possible, improving analysis and modeling efficiency.

rotating-calipers.title: Diameter of a Point Set Algorithm Visualization
rotating-calipers.summary: A BUAA Algorithm Analysis and Design course assignment, using Java to visualize the solution process for the farthest pair of points in a plane.
points: Allows users to create arbitrary points on a plane, then shows the process of building the convex hull and using rotating calipers to find the farthest pair of points.

oop-iteration-2022.title: School of Software Cloud Platform (Youth Edition)
oop-iteration-2022.summary: A BUAA Object-Oriented Programming (Java) iterative assignment project, with requirements released in four rounds. It includes teacher and student clients and implements most functions of the traditional SCS system.
points: Practiced Java object-oriented modeling and code organization through multiple rounds of iterative tasks.
The teacher client supports creating, deleting, updating, and querying courses and their experiments, and teachers can also add students and teaching assistants to courses.
Students can view and participate in courses and submit experiment assignments, while teaching assistants can collaborate with teachers on course management.

career-yiyan.title: Career YIYAN Recruitment Website
career-yiyan.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Comprehensive Practice short-term project. It covers the complete workflow of company recruitment and user job seeking, and improves user experience through feeds, private messages, notifications, and large-model-assisted features.
points: Strictly followed the Scrum agile process, used the platform provided by the course team to manage the Scrum board, and completed two requirement iterations in 11 days.

Deeply participated in the full Scrum process, held daily Scrum standups, continuously tracked user story points, and practiced pair programming, automated code review and checks, and manual code review.
Companies can manage employees, company information, recruitment positions, and job information; job seekers can upload and manage resumes and apply to target companies.
Users and companies can publish, like, and comment on posts, making it easier for both sides to understand each other more fully.
Users can send and manage private messages, making communication between job seekers and HR closer.
Implemented a notification system so users do not miss private messages, likes, or comments on posts.
Used a large model to provide suggestions for improving resumes uploaded by users.

cloud-yiyan.title: Cloud YIYAN Software Engineering Team Collaboration and Management Platform
cloud-yiyan.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Basic Practice short-term project. A team collaboration Web platform with team project management, collaborative document editing, chat, page prototype design, and message notifications.
points: Strictly followed an agile development process, held daily standups, completed daily reports, and used Alibaba Cloud DevOps to manage progress, completing two requirement iterations in 10 days.
Uses projects as the unit for team management, chat, documents, and prototype design, allowing users to create, join, and manage projects.

Provides project documents that support rich text and multi-user online collaborative editing. Users can also mention other users in documents or share documents with external users using desired permissions.
Provides chat and communication features, allowing users to send text, images, files, and other messages to other users or groups they create, and to view delivery and read status.
Provides online prototype design features for creating and editing Web page prototypes as references for later page development.
Implements a message notification system that notifies users when they are mentioned in documents or receive new chat messages.
Collected development and technical summaries from every team member, preserving and sharing knowledge to contribute experience for later team development.

yiyan-microservices.title: YIYAN Academic Achievement Sharing Platform
yiyan-microservices.summary: A BUAA Software System Analysis and Design course assignment. An efficient, high-concurrency, and highly available academic achievement sharing platform based on Vue, Java, Kubernetes, and Elastic Search.
points: Went through a complete process from requirement research, requirement modeling, analysis model construction, architecture research and design, data design, coding, and deployment, with documents preserved.
Split different modules into microservices and scheduled them onto suitable nodes according to their task characteristics.
Supports full-text literature search and advanced search, combining keywords through operators such as AND, OR, and NOT.
Analyzes and visualizes researchers' research directions, collaboration relationships, and literature citation relationships.
Provides personalized literature recommendations based on users' historical reading, downloads, and favorites.
Allows readers to post discussions about literature or cite literature in column articles for analysis and introduction.

compiler.title: SysY MIPS Compiler
compiler.summary: A BUAA Compiler Technology course experiment assignment. A 32-bit MIPS compiler for the SysY language implemented in Java, including lexical analysis, syntax analysis, intermediate code generation, target code generation, and error handling.
points: SysY is a subset of the C language and does not include pointer variables or floating-point numbers.
Controls compiler behavior through configuration options, including optimization and detailed output for each stage.
Supports detailed output with recursive structures and displays real-time symbol tables to make debugging easier.
Uses compiler optimization techniques such as constant propagation, strength reduction, and pointer constant optimization to improve target-code performance.

learning-living-platform.title: YIYAN Learning and Living Platform
learning-living-platform.summary: A BUAA Software Engineering Basics course assignment. A frontend-backend separated team project from the School of Software, allowing users to share and download educational resources or join an online learning community to exchange thoughts and experiences.
points: Used the waterfall model for project management and produced a full set of process documents from requirements analysis and system design to final deployment and maintenance.
Designed a frontend that fits the task style, provides detailed prompts, and embeds usage guidance to deliver a better user experience.
Used JWT Token for authentication and a heartbeat mechanism to detect whether users are online.
Developed an in-house resource deletion queue algorithm to ensure unreferenced dead resources do not accumulate in platform storage.
Deployed the frontend, backend, and database in the cloud, used nginx for load balancing, and implemented CI/CD through GitHub Actions.

archive-system.title: Java Archive Management System
archive-system.summary: A BUAA Object-Oriented Programming (Java) assignment project. A frontend-backend separated archive management system for libraries or archives.
points: An assignment from when I was first learning Java, supporting user management, archive upload, download, search, deletion, and related functions.
Implemented the GUI with Java Swing and used FlatLaf to provide different style and theme choices.
Used Git for version management and provided detailed guidance and prompts for users to improve the user experience.
